definitions.gloss: personal connections; ties of family or acquaintance
definitions.explanation: A relationship through family, marriage, or acquaintance, especially when it is used to get a job or some other advantage. In hiring it suggests favoritism.

examples.japanese: {縁故|えんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}した→入社する：25409_nyuushasuru⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently he got the job through connections.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧、{子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}って→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧{縁故|えんこ}⟦{疎開|そかい}→疎開：13589_sokai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the war, the children were evacuated to relatives in the countryside.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう}: hiring through personal connections
- {縁故|えんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たよ}る→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: to rely on one's connections
- {縁故|えんこ}⟦{疎開|そかい}→疎開：13589_sokai⟧: wartime evacuation to relatives' homes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- コネ: connections, the everyday word ({縁故|えんこ}{採用|さいよう} is コネ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧ in casual speech)
- ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧: a bond or fate that links people, wider and more abstract
- ⟦{人脈|じんみゃく}→人脈：18253_jinmyaku⟧: a network of contacts built up through work
